## 1. Introduction

### 1.1 Purpose

This FSD specifies the functional requirements for upgrading pi-coding-agent from 0.80.10 to 0.99.1 to enable the native PowerShell tool on Windows, replacing the fragile Git-Bash workaround. It covers dependency management, tool wiring, workflow gate updates, and verification testing.

### 1.2 Scope

- Upgrade all `@earendil-works/*` packages to 0.99.1 in lockstep
- Wire `createPowerShellTool` on win32, `createBashTool` otherwise
- Remove Git-Bash shellPath pin and normalizeBashCommandPaths spawnHook for Windows
- Update workflow gate classification (READ_ONLY_TOOLS, DANGEROUS_TOOLS)
- Update system prompt, tool loadout, classifyTool mapping
- Add automated verification tests for PowerShell tool name and behavior
- **Epic:** SA4E-289 — Migrate LangGraph Workflow Engine to Pi SDK

### 1.3 Definitions & Acronyms

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| pi-coding-agent | Earendil Works coding agent SDK |
| PowerShell tool | Native Windows PowerShell execution tool via pwsh.exe |
| Git-Bash workaround | Previous shellPath + normalizeBashCommandPaths spawnHook for path translation |
| createPowerShellTool | Pi SDK function to create a PowerShell execution tool |
| createBashTool | Pi SDK function to create a Bash execution tool |
| VSIX | Visual Studio extension package format |
| UAT | User Acceptance Testing |

## 2. System Overview

### 2.1 System Context Diagram

![System Context](data:image/png;base64,)

*[Edit in draw.io](diagrams/system-context.drawio)*

The system boundary encompasses the VS Code Extension that interacts with:
- **pi-coding-agent 0.99.1** — upgraded SDK providing native PowerShell tool
- **PowerShell (pwsh.exe)** — Windows shell execution provider
- **Windows OS** — platform providing OS-level APIs
- **Backend Knowledge Service** — REST API at `/api/v1/*` for thread/checkpoint persistence
- **VS Code IDE** — IDE surface for developer interaction

### 2.2 System Architecture

**Extension modules involved:**

| Module | File | Responsibility |
|--------|------|----------------|
| pi-workflow-tools | `extension/src/pi-workflow/pi-coding-tools.ts` | Tool factory — OS-aware shell selection |
| pi-workflow-gate | `extension/src/pi-workflow/pi-workflow-gate.ts` | Workflow gate classification |
| pi-agent-session | `extension/src/pi-workflow/pi-agent-session-host.ts` | Session tool loadout |
| turn-budget-guard | `extension/src/pi-workflow/turn-budget-guard.ts` | Budget guard with shell-aware correction |
| StreamProtocolAdapter | `extension/src/pi-workflow/stream-protocol-adapter.ts` | Tool classification for stream protocol |

**Architecture pattern:** Extension uses Pi SDK 0.99.1 factory pattern. The `createWorkspaceTools` function is the single entry point for tool creation, now OS-aware.

## 3. Functional Requirements

### 3.1 Feature: Upgrade pi-coding-agent to 0.99.1

**Source:** BRD Story 1 (SA4E-336)

#### 3.1.1 Description

Upgrade `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` and all peer packages to 0.99.1. All `@earendil-works/*` packages must be bumped in lockstep to avoid version mismatch. Single resolved version must be verified with `npm ls`.

#### 3.1.2 Use Case

**Use Case ID:** UC-1
**Actor:** Developer
**Preconditions:** Workspace on upgrade branch; Node engine compatibility confirmed; pi-coding-agent 0.80.10 currently installed
**Postconditions:** All @earendil-works/* packages at 0.99.1; TypeScript compiles cleanly

**Main Flow:**

| Step | Actor | System | Description |
|------|-------|--------|-------------|
| 1 | Developer | | Initiates upgrade on upgrade branch |
| 2 | | npm | Resolves @earendil-works/* dependencies |
| 3 | | npm | Installs pi-coding-agent 0.99.1 and peers |
| 4 | | TypeScript | Compiles extension/tsconfig.json |
| 5 | | npm | Verifies single resolved version (npm ls) |

**Alternative Flows:**

| ID | Condition | Steps |
|----|-----------|-------|
| AF-1 | Node engine incompatible | Check engines.node before bump; halt if Node ≥22 required but not available |
| AF-2 | Duplicate pi-agent-core instances | Run npm ls, dedupe with npm dedupe or resolution fields |

**Exception Flows:**

| ID | Condition | Steps |
|----|-----------|-------|
| EF-1 | TypeScript compile errors | Review 0.99.1 .d.ts; fix type errors; no `as any` shortcuts |
| EF-2 | npm resolution conflict | Check lock file; force resolution of @earendil-works/* to 0.99.1 |

#### 3.1.3 Business Rules

| Rule ID | Rule | Source |
|---------|------|--------|
| BR-1 | All @earendil-works/* packages must match version 0.99.1 | BRD Story 1 |
| BR-2 | Version must be semver compatible | BRD Story 1 |
| BR-3 | No `as any` shortcuts for type errors | BRD Story 1 |
| BR-4 | Upgrade must be on a branch | BRD Business Flow Step 11 |

#### 3.1.4 Data Specifications

**Input Data:**

| Field | Type | Required | Validation | Description |
|-------|------|----------|------------|-------------|
| packageName | string | Yes | NPM package name format | NPM package name |
| currentVersion | semver | Yes | Must match 0.80.10 | Installed version |
| targetVersion | semver | Yes | Must be 0.99.1 | Desired version |

**Output Data:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| resolvedVersion | string | Single resolved version from npm ls |
| compileStatus | boolean | true if npx tsc --noEmit passes |

#### 3.1.5 UI Specifications

N/A — this is a dependency/SDK upgrade task, no UI changes.

#### 3.1.6 API Contract (Functional View)

> **Note:** No REST API changes — this is a build-time dependency bump.

**Endpoint:** N/A
**Purpose:** SDK version upgrade for downstream tool functionality

### 3.2 Feature: Enable native PowerShell tool on Windows

**Source:** BRD Story 2 (SA4E-336)

#### 3.2.1 Description

Replace Git-Bash workaround with native PowerShell on Windows. In `pi-coding-tools.ts`, `createWorkspaceTools` selects shellTool based on `process.platform`: `createPowerShellTool(workspaceRoot)` on win32, `createBashTool(workspaceRoot)` otherwise. Retire `resolveGitBashPath` and `normalizeBashCommandPaths` for Windows.

#### 3.2.2 Use Case

**Use Case ID:** UC-2
**Actor:** Developer (Windows)
**Preconditions:** pi-coding-agent 0.99.1 installed; Windows platform detected
**Postconditions:** PowerShell tool available; bash tool available on non-Windows

**Main Flow:**

| Step | Actor | System | Description |
|------|-------|--------|-------------|
| 1 | | Extension | Detects process.platform === 'win32' |
| 2 | | Extension | Calls createPowerShellTool(workspaceRoot) |
| 3 | Developer | PowerShell | Executes commands with c:\ paths natively |
| 4 | | Extension | Uses PowerShell toolSystemPromptContribution |

**Alternative Flows:**

| ID | Condition | Steps |
|----|-----------|-------|
| AF-1 | pwsh.exe not found | Fallback to Windows PowerShell |
| AF-2 | Non-Windows platform | Use createBashTool(workspaceRoot) |

**Exception Flows:**

| ID | Condition | Steps |
|----|-----------|-------|
| EF-1 | PowerShell execution fails | Error handled by existing error handling; report to user |

#### 3.2.3 Business Rules

| Rule ID | Rule | Source |
|---------|------|--------|
| BR-5 | Tool name must be "powershell" on Windows | BRD Story 2 |
| BR-6 | No shellPath option passed to createPowerShellTool | BRD Story 2 |
| BR-7 | Bash tool retained on non-Windows | BRD Story 2 |

#### 3.2.4 Data Specifications

**Input Data:**

| Field | Type | Required | Validation | Description |
|-------|------|----------|------------|-------------|
| platform | string | Yes | process.platform === 'win32' | OS platform |
| workspaceRoot | string | Yes | Valid directory path | Workspace root |

**Output Data:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| toolName | string | "powershell" (win32) or "bash" (non-win32) |
| toolSystemPrompt | string | PowerShell dialect prompt on Windows |

#### 3.2.5 UI Specifications

N/A — internal tool wiring, no UI surface change.

#### 3.2.6 API Contract (Functional View)

> **Note:** This is an internal SDK call, no REST API involved.

**Endpoint:** N/A
**Purpose:** OS-aware shell tool creation

### 3.3 Feature: Update workflow gates and classification

**Source:** BRD Story 3 (SA4E-336)

#### 3.3.1 Description

Update workflow gates to classify PowerShell like bash for approval. Four files need changes:
1. `pi-workflow-gate.ts` — add powershell to READ_ONLY_TOOLS and DANGEROUS_TOOLS
2. `turn-budget-guard.ts` — shell-aware buildFailureSteerCorrection
3. `StreamProtocolAdapter classifyTool` — map powershell → shell
4. `pi-agent-session-host.ts` — update session tool loadout

#### 3.3.2 Use Case

**Use Case ID:** UC-3
**Actor:** Product Owner / System
**Preconditions:** PowerShell tool wired (UC-2 complete)
**Postconditions:** PowerShell classified correctly in workflow gates; UI renders TOOL powershell

**Main Flow:**

| Step | Actor | System | Description |
|------|-------|--------|-------------|
| 1 | | Extension | Reads READ_ONLY_TOOLS / DANGEROUS_TOOLS lists |
| 2 | | Extension | Classifies powershell operations |
| 3 | | Autopilot | Auto-approves read-only powershell |
| 4 | | Autopilot | Requests approval for destructive powershell |
| 5 | | UI | Renders TOOL powershell correctly |

**Alternative Flows:**

| ID | Condition | Steps |
|----|-----------|-------|
| AF-1 | Destructive PowerShell command | Require approval gate |
| AF-2 | Read-only PowerShell command | Auto-approve |

**Exception Flows:**

| ID | Condition | Steps |
|----|-----------|-------|
| EF-1 | Unknown PowerShell command | Default to dangerous — require approval |

#### 3.3.3 Business Rules

| Rule ID | Rule | Source |
|---------|------|--------|
| BR-8 | Autopilot auto-approves read-only powershell operations | BRD Story 3 |
| BR-9 | Destructive PowerShell commands require approval | BRD Story 3 |
| BR-10 | UI renders TOOL powershell correctly | BRD Story 3 |
| BR-11 | classifyTool maps powershell → shell | BRD Story 3 |
| BR-12 | buildFailureSteerCorrection is shell-aware | BRD Story 3 |

#### 3.3.4 Data Specifications

**Input Data:**

| Field | Type | Required | Validation | Description |
|-------|------|----------|------------|-------------|
| toolName | string | Yes | "powershell" or "bash" | Tool identifier |
| command | string | Yes | PowerShell command text | Command to classify |
| isReadOnly | boolean | Yes | true/false | Read-only determination |

**Output Data:**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| classification | string | "read-only", "dangerous", "unknown" |
| requiresApproval | boolean | true if approval needed |

#### 3.3.5 UI Specifications

**Screen: Tool Classification Display**

| No. | Element | Type | Required | Behavior | Validation |
|-----|---------|------|----------|----------|------------|
| 1 | Tool name display | Text | Yes | Shows "powershell" on Windows | Matches toolName |
| 2 | Approval indicator | Badge | Yes | Shows approval status | Reflects classification |
| 3 | Command display | Text | Yes | Shows executed command | Truncated if too long |

#### 3.3.6 API Contract (Functional View)

> **Note:** No REST API changes — workflow gate logic is internal.

**Endpoint:** N/A
**Purpose:** Tool classification for approval workflow

## 6. Processing Logic

### 6.1 Upgrade Process

**Trigger:** Developer initiates upgrade on upgrade branch
**Schedule:** One-time migration task
**Input:** Current pi-coding-agent 0.80.10 + dependencies
**Output:** Upgraded pi-coding-agent 0.99.1 + verified working state

**Processing Steps:**

| Step | Description | Error Handling |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| 1 | Bump @earendil-works/* to 0.99.1 in package.json files | Halt if Node engine incompatible |
| 2 | npm install — resolve dependencies | Dedupe if duplicate trees |
| 3 | npx tsc --noEmit — type check | Fix against .d.ts, no `as any` |
| 4 | npm ls — verify single version | Force resolution if duplicates |
| 5 | Wire createPowerShellTool on win32 | Fallback to Windows PowerShell |
| 6 | Remove Git-Bash workaround for Windows | Keep for non-Windows |
| 7 | Update workflow gates (READ_ONLY/DANGEROUS) | Default to dangerous if unknown |
| 8 | Update system prompt for PowerShell dialect | Keep bash prompt on non-Windows |
| 9 | Update session tool loadout | Verify classifyTool mapping |
| 10 | Run unit tests + PowerShell-specific tests | Fix failing tests |
| 11 | Package VSIX | Rebuild if packaging fails |
| 12 | UAT with full project review | Revert on critical failure |

## 7. Security Requirements

### 7.1 Authentication & Authorization

| Role | Permissions | Screens/Features |
|------|-------------|-------------------|
| Developer | Read/Write/Admin | Upgrade execution, tool configuration |
| Product Owner | Read/Approve | Workflow gate approval rules |
| QA Engineer | Read/Test | Verification test execution |

### 7.2 Data Sensitivity Classification

| Data Type | Classification | Business Requirement |
|-----------|---------------|---------------------|
| PowerShell commands | Internal | Commands may contain credentials; approval gate required |
| Workspace paths | Internal | Path translation must not leak to logs |
| npm package versions | Public | Version info is non-sensitive |

### 7.3 Audit Trail

| Event | Logged Fields | Retention | Business Reason |
|-------|--------------|-----------|-----------------|
| Upgrade executed | version from, version to, timestamp, platform | 90 days | Traceability for rollback |
| PowerShell command | command, toolName, timestamp, approval status | Session | Security review |
| Workflow gate decision | classification, command, approved_by | Session | Compliance |

## 9. Error Handling (User-Facing)

### 9.1 Error Scenarios

| Scenario | Severity | User Message | Expected Behavior |
|----------|----------|-------------|-------------------|
| TypeScript compile error after upgrade | Critical | "Upgrade blocked: TypeScript errors detected. Review 0.99.1 .d.ts definitions." | Halt upgrade; guide to fix types |
| pwsh.exe not found on Windows | Warning | "PowerShell not found. Falling back to Windows PowerShell." | Fallback to pwsh-compatible mode |
| Duplicate pi-agent-core instances | Critical | "Duplicate dependencies detected. Run npm dedupe." | Block deployment until resolved |
| Node engine incompatible | Critical | "Node engine incompatible. Required: ≥22." | Block upgrade |
| PowerShell command approval denied | Info | "Command requires approval. Please review and approve." | Wait for approval |

### 9.2 Notification Requirements

| Event | Who is Notified | Channel | Timing |
|-------|----------------|---------|--------|
| Upgrade completed | Developer | In-app notification | Immediate |
| Upgrade failed | Developer | In-app notification | Immediate |
| Destructive command detected | Product Owner | In-app + email | Immediate |

## 10. Testing Considerations

### 10.1 Test Scenarios

| ID | Scenario | Input | Expected Output | Priority |
